description: Selected automated technical checks associated with CIS Critical Security Controls v8 safeguards.
report_title: CIS Controls v8 Technical Check Evidence
legal_context: The CIS Critical Security Controls are a prioritized, widely adopted set of safeguards. Regulators, courts and insurers commonly cite them as a benchmark of reasonable security, and implementation groups IG1 to IG3 give a defensible baseline for organizations of any size.
